programs.title: Frugal Foodie
programs.desc: Pasta dishes that are quick, easy, and satisfying, featuring everything from Pesto Canneloni to Pumpkin Rigatoni with Capsicum and Feta, the family will keep coming back for more.

programs.title: Jose Andres And Family In Spain
programs.desc: Chef Jose Andres shares the gastronomic secrets of Spain's Catalonia region with his daughters as he revisits the people and places that have shaped his life and career.

programs.title: Come Dine With Me The Professionals
programs.desc: Today's new Come Dine With Me: The Professionals heads to Yorkshire where first to host are purveyors of posh nosh, Chef-Owner Ben and front of house Jo at their intimate dining restaurant The Barn.

programs.title: Torres Strait At Home
programs.desc: Torres Strait Islander chef and owner of Mabu Mabu, Nornie Bero, cooks and talks through some of her favourite easy recipes, from quick picked octopus to fresh baked damper.

programs.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
programs.desc: It's all about superb herbs as Refugee Ambassador Yaser Naseri and Special Representative to Australia for UNHCR, Dr. Carina Hoang, join Adam to celebrate Refugee Week.

programs.title: Cheese Slices
programs.desc: Will's cheese tour takes him across the United States to look at artisanal cheese in regions not normally associated with specialist cheese.

programs.title: Flat Out Food
programs.desc: Jenn discovers how lentils are a popular Saskatchewan crop that's often just shipped overseas. A farmer, a brewer and a chef are changing that for the better.

programs.title: Destination Flavour Down Under
programs.desc: It is one tropical surprise after another when Adam takes to the road around Rockhampton, beginning his trip at a petrol station known for making the best crab sandwiches in QLD.

programs.title: Great Chocolate Showdown
programs.desc: The remaining five bakers must rise to the occasion as they bake chocolate bread and use it to make a dessert deli sandwich. In the Elimination Challenge, the bakers look to the silver screen.

programs.title: Please Eat Slowly Bitesize
programs.desc: Victor shows how easy it is to make fresh noodles at home: all you need is flour, water and a little bit of time!

programs.title: On Country Kitchen
programs.desc: Mark and Derek visit a chicken farm with a view, take in an afternoon of fishing together and learn about the methode traditionelle of sparkling winemaking. Mark takes Derek sightseeing.

programs.title: Rachael Ray's Meals In Minutes
programs.sub_title: Spaghetti With Semi-Dried Tomato Pesto & Broccolini
programs.desc: Semi-dried tomatoes, a fairly new staple in American grocery stores, are both bitter and sweet at the same time; they have big flavour, an easy chew and Rachael demonstrates how to use them as the star.
